title: Block-triangular exponential as master object for Fréchet exp and phi actions
expression_sketch:
Mathias / Higham block identity. Let D be open in R or C, f be (2n-1)-times C^1 on D, and spec(X) subset D. Then
  f( [[X, E], [0, X]] ) = [[ f(X), L_f(X, E) ], [ 0, f(X) ]].
For f = exp (entire; drop the 2n-1 hypothesis):
  exp( [[A, E], [0, A]] ) = [[ exp(A), L_exp(A, E) ], [ 0, exp(A) ]],
  L_exp(A, E) = Integral(exp((1-s)*A)*E*exp(s*A), (s, 0, 1)).
Phi-action specializations (Al-Mohy-Higham 2011 Thm 2.1 / Sidje / Saad):
  exp( [[A, c], [0, 0]] ) = [[ exp(A), phi_1(A)*c ], [ 0, 1 ]],
and with J the p x p nilpotent Jordan block of 0 and W = [w_1,...,w_p],
  exp( [[A, W], [0, J]] ) has first-block columns equal to linear combinations of phi_k(A) w_j.
Scalar 2x2 (SymPy series):
  exp( [[z, 1], [0, 0]] ) = [[ exp(z), (exp(z)-1)/z ], [ 0, 1 ]]  (z != 0),
  with entire continuation of the (1,2) entry equal to 1 at z = 0.
latent_structure: One master analytic object — the exponential of a block-triangular augmentation — simultaneously produces exp(A), the Fréchet derivative L_exp(A,E), and the exponential-integrator phi_k(A)w actions as blocks. This is Van Loan's integral trick plus Mathias's block-function identity. The off-diagonal block is the same divided-difference / Duhamel object as in the Daleckii-Krein and phi dossiers, now packaged as a single matrix function evaluation.

function_domains.f: C^{2n-1} on an open set D containing spec(X) (Mathias Thm 2.1)
function_domains.exp: entire on C; primary matrix exponential on all square complex matrices

positivity_conditions.statement: Duhamel / phi integral parameter s (or theta) ranges over the compact interval [0, 1]
positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED

branch_conventions: Primary matrix function of the 2n x 2n block matrix; not an entrywise exponential.
The (1,2) scalar entry (e^z-1)/z is the entire continuation (value 1 at 0).

why_not_cse_lgg: The expanded Duhamel integral, the phi_1 action, and the Fréchet block look like unrelated expressions. CSE will not wrap them as blocks of one matrix exponential. LGG will not invent the block-triangular augmentation. This is a master-object representation (one exp of a larger matrix) with multiple structurally distinct members.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide: Van Loan, Mathias, Fréchet, phi, Duhamel, block triangular, augmentation. Show the expanded 2x2 exponential entries and the integral formula as unlabeled members. Do not mention that they are blocks of one exponential.
notes: SciML role: simultaneous evaluation of exp and sensitivities; exponential-integrator phi-actions without naming phi.
